title: Lab B: Contain the Blast Radius
description: Rebuild the vulnerable integration so the Lab A attack can't happen, using two controls outside the model: least privilege via a Managed vMCP that curates the tool surface, and data filtering at the gateway. Then learn why filters must be tested.
